title: The Vedic Roots
description: Ancient agrarian society centered on sacred riverbanks and ritualistic food preparation.

visuals.environment: Ancient Indian riverbank with mud-brick structures and sacred fires.
visuals.cooking: Clay pots over open fires, community gathering around a central hearth.

title: Gupta Golden Age
description: The flowering of temple culture, refined vegetarianism, and Ayurvedic wisdom.

visuals.environment: Ornate stone temples, vibrant university courtyards, and lush gardens.
visuals.cooking: Advanced fermentation vessels, brass and bronze utensils, sophisticated spice blends.
visuals.lighting: Golden hour sunlight filtering through stone arches.

title: Medieval Kingdoms
description: Rise of powerful regional dynasties and the solidification of distinct culinary identities.

visuals.environment: Stone hill forts, bustling inland trade markets, and regional administrative hubs.
visuals.cooking: Stone-ground spices, massive community cauldrons, and regional grain storage.
visuals.lighting: Harsh midday desert sun and cool fortress interiors.

title: The Sultanates
description: Early Islamic influence, introduction of Persian techniques and Middle Eastern ingredients.

visuals.environment: Arch-filled marketplaces, towering minarets, and early Indo-Islamic gardens.
visuals.cooking: Introduction of the tandoor, skewered meats, and refined pastry techniques.
visuals.lighting: Flickering oil lamps and crowded market shadows.

title: Mughal Splendor
description: Peak of Indo-Persian fusion, royal feasts, and the introduction of nuts and saffron.

visuals.environment: Marble palaces, geometric Persian gardens, and silk-draped courts.
visuals.cooking: Slow-cooked 'Dum' techniques, rich gravies, and gold-leaf garnished royal platters.
visuals.lighting: Soft candlelit marble halls and lush moonlit gardens.

title: Colonial Era
description: The arrival of New World crops and the influence of European trade on coastal ports.

visuals.environment: Colonial bungalows, tea plantations, and bustling industrial harbor ports.
visuals.cooking: Introduction of potatoes and tomatoes, high-tea culture, and Anglo-Indian fusion.
visuals.lighting: Cool misty harbor light and industrial smog.

title: Modern Pulse
description: The explosion of street food culture, globalization, and rapid urban evolution.

visuals.environment: Neon-lit city streets, massive railway stations, and high-rise skylines.
visuals.cooking: Quick-fire street snacks, international fusion, and the rise of home delivery.
visuals.lighting: Vibrant neon signs and high-contrast urban shadows.

title: Ethereal Future
description: A return to traditional wisdom powered by AI nutrition and vertical farming.

visuals.environment: Bio-integrated green towers, floating vertical farms, and high-tech minimalist spaces.
visuals.cooking: Precision nutrient mapping, lab-grown heritage proteins, and 3D printed spice DNA.
visuals.lighting: Clean, soft bioluminescent glow and natural light integration.
